ModMetaData.name: Animal Tab — Unofficial Update
ModMetaData.author: Fluffy (original); Noslon (unofficial maintenance)
ModMetaData.description:
Unofficial maintenance fork of Animal Tab by Fluffy, maintained by Noslon (Warnu on GitHub).
Enhanced animal information, sorting, filtering, and handler controls.
This update prevents null-reference failures in milk/wool status checks from interrupting the entire table. An affected cell stays blank, one diagnostic warning identifies the animal, and the status is retried after one second. Normal production rules are unchanged.
Enable this fork INSTEAD OF the original Animal Tab. Never enable both. Requires Harmony.
Experimental RimWorld 1.7 release candidate. The code change was tested locally on 1.7.4981 rev136; the standalone package and third-party integrations still need in-game testing. This does not claim to repair the underlying invalid map state. Add-ons that explicitly require Fluffy.AnimalTab may need compatibility updates for this fork's distinct package ID.
Original mod: https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=712141500 Original source: https://github.com/fluffy-mods/AnimalTab Fork source and issues: https://github.com/Warnu/AnimalTab
Code and documentation: MIT. Original assets: generally CC BY-SA 4.0, with third-party exceptions preserved in CREDITS.md and LICENSE. Original artwork is unchanged. This unofficial fork is not endorsed by Fluffy.
